name: Cortes' Cilantro-Lime Marinated Caribbean Grouper Fillet (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: White grouper fillet and white rice are a 9.5/10 flare meal when cooked without the cilantro-lime marinade and black beans.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the grouper fillet pan-seared plain with salt and olive oil only (zero lime marinade) over plain steamed white rice (no black beans).
watchOuts: Lime juice in standard marinade (order plain)
Whole black beans in rice side
